cases.name: Megan Elizabeth McShane
cases.about: Her obituary said: "A graduate of Norwalk High School, she attended Palm Beach Atlantic University , and worked in various jobs, including elder caregiving and catering. She loved the water, boating, gardening, outdoors and dogs. With gratitude for her simple, beautiful life, we mark the passing of Megan. Her Zen practice taught her to appreciate each moment as it came, and her presence was a quiet, constant gift to her family and friends."
cases.narrative: When police responded to the their apartment they found Mulvey lying on top of Megan's body with a large kitchen knife nearby. Once taken into custody, Mulvey continued to confess repeatedly that night, crying and spontaneously stated, “I can’t believe I killed my girlfriend,” “I can’t believe I did it,” “my baby’s dead,” and “Oh my, baby, I’m sorry.”
